description: Use this when the user wants to translate a public webpage, documentation or public-domain text that they own or have the rights to translate. Input tips: url of the page (http or https), target_lang as a language code such as vi, es, fr, de, ja, zh, pt, ko, and confirm_rights true only after the user confirms the rights. Returns: clean Markdown with headings, lists and code kept, usually in 5 to 15 seconds for a page of up to 8,000 characters, plus characters left today. Not for: copyrighted fiction, manga, manhwa or commercial comics, pasted text, local files or pages behind a login. Errors and next step: rights_not_confirmed (ask the user, then set confirm_rights true); page_too_large over 12,000 characters (offer a shorter page, such as one chapter on its own URL); fetch_failed or no_content (check the URL opens without a login, or pick a page whose text is in the HTML); daily_translation_spent (the daily character limit is used up; try again after 00:00 UTC); translation_failed (try again in a minute).

confirm_rights.description: Set true only after the user has confirmed they own this page or have the rights to translate it (docs, public domain, or user-owned content). Must not be used for copyrighted fiction or comics.

source_lang.description: Optional ISO 639-1 code of the page language, such as en. Read from the page HTML (or en) when omitted.

target_lang.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language to translate into, such as vi (Vietnamese), es, fr, de, ja, zh, pt, ko, ru, ar or hi. A few are 3 letters: ast, ceb, ilo.

url.description: Public webpage URL to fetch and translate, such as https://example.com/docs/start (http or https; local and private addresses are blocked).

name: translate_page

outputSchema.description: A finished translation. A refused or failed call has no result in this shape: it comes back as an error whose text starts with its code (rights_not_confirmed, invalid_url, blocked_url, fetch_failed, no_content, page_too_large, daily_translation_spent or translation_failed) and says what to do next.

as_of.description: When the translation was made (ISO 8601 UTC).

character_count.description: Characters of page text that were translated.

markdown.description: Clean translated Markdown containing headings, paragraphs, and lists.

notes.description: Facts to pass on, such as a reminder to check machine translation before publishing.

source_lang.description: Language code the page was translated from.

status.description: Always ok: errors come back as error text, not as a result.

target_lang.description: Language code the page was translated into.

title.description: The page title as written on the page, not translated.

url.description: The page address that was fetched.

characters_charged.description: Characters this call took from today's limit.

characters_left_today.description: Characters still free to translate today; the limit resets at 00:00 UTC.

title: Translate a webpage or documentation
